name: fmp_sec_filings
description:
SEC filings for one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/sec-filings): form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1 and others), filing date and links.
Returns {symbol, filings}: FMP's list of filing records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), type (form type filter, e.g. 10-K), limit (integer; default 5).
For filing content use the edgar_* tools; for 13F holdings of a fund fmp_13f_filing.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "type": "10-K", "limit": 5}
